about: Researched labels for frequencies the app's own reference table does not name. dashboard2.py reads this file whenever it changes (no restart needed) and uses it to name what shows on the spectrum strip. An entry is: MHz with four decimals -> name (short label, capitals like the rest of the airband set), what (one line), src (a key under sources). The reference table in sdr_scan.py comes first, this file second, the ISED licence database third. Peaks that none of them can name collect in unknown_freqs.json - the list to research from. Rule kept when this file was built: where the ISED licence database names a different holder than a hobby list does, the hobby list's entry was left out.

sources.canairradio: https://canairradio.ca/yyz.html - Toronto Pearson and Toronto ACC frequency list (page last updated 15 April 2020), read 15 Nov 2026
sources.rr_ytz: https://radioreference.com/db/aid/5636 - Billy Bishop Toronto City Airport, read 15 Nov 2026
sources.sigid_acars: https://www.sigidwiki.com/wiki/ACARS - ACARS channel list, read 15 Nov 2026
